candidate_checkpoints: every completed epoch checkpoint, EMA weights, numeric epoch order
metric_ties: exact equality of supplied full-precision serialized P5 values; never rounded display values
metric_definitions: provided by the versioned P5 evaluator; aggregation and matching not reimplemented in P2
raw_candidate_retention: fixed NMS at inclusive 0.1; preserve row order and empty masks; no area/component/final T0 filtering at collection
output_adapter: pending agreed P4/P5 0.1% area, components, RLE and score=1.0 ordering rules
final_val: never used for selection; export only after freeze and dev mask-validation gates
